    return (formatted_number, mobile_number) => {
        var phoneNumberElements = document.querySelectorAll('.js-phone-link');
        phoneNumberElements.forEach(el => {
            if (el) {
                el.href = `tel:${mobile_number}`;
                //this check is necessary to ignore changing the content in case the phone number content is an svg icon or an image.
                if (el.innerHTML.trim() === site_phone_number.trim()) {
                    el.innerHTML = '';
                    el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(formatted_number));
                }
            }
        });
    };
}

Inventory management software helps retailers maintain accurate records of their inventory, streamline operations and optimize their stock based on sales trends and forecasts.<br><br> Stores can keep track of inventory using inventory management systems that monitor stock levels, manage reordering and track sales. Systems like Lightspeed update in seconds, helping to ensure that sales and stock levels are always synchronized. It also provides analytics to help retailers make informed decisions about stock replenishment and markdowns.<br><br> An inventory tracking system is a part of inventory management that focuses specifically on monitoring the quantities of goods in stock, and potentially their location within a store or warehouse. A POS (Point of Sale) inventory management system integrates the sales and inventory functions, enabling automatic tracking of inventory as sales occur. This system helps retailers understand what is selling well and what isn’t, allowing them to adjust purchasing and marketing strategies accordingly. It simplifies the sales process by automatically updating inventory levels as transactions are processed at the point of sale.<br><br> This system is crucial for retailers to ensure they have the right products in the right quantities at the right time, maximizing sales potential and minimizing holding costs.</p></div></details><details class=" gb-ui-dropdown-icon tw:border tw:border-solid tw:border-tertiary tw:rounded-md tw:mb-6 tw:relative tw:select-none " data-js="accordion"><summary class="tw:cursor-pointer tw:font-lsMedium tw:pt-4.5 tw:pr-18 tw:pb-4.5 tw:pl-6"><h3 class="gb-h4 gb-no-margin-bottom">Which inventory system is best for a small business?</h3></summary><div class=" tw:mb-0 tw:mt-4.5 tw:text-primary tw:pt-4.5 tw:pr-18 tw:pb-4.5 tw:pl-6 tw:[&_li]:list-disc " data-accordion="content"><p>Choosing the best inventory system for a small business depends on several factors, including the business's size, budget and specific operational needs. Software for inventory management should offer features like automatic stock level updates, multi-channel sales integration, supplier and purchase order management, and detailed analytics on inventory turnover and sales trends. The ideal software also includes forecasting tools to help predict future sales and inventory needs based on historical data.<br><br> To pick the right system for your business:<br><br> 1. Assess needs: determine what features are most important for your business, such as sales tracking, order management or customer data integration.<br> 2. Choose software: select software that fits your budget and meets your identified needs. It should allow for easy input and tracking of inventory, sales monitoring and data analysis.<br> 3. Set up and integration: implement the software, set up product categories and integrate it with other systems like accounting or customer relationship management (CRM) if necessary. Look for professional onboarding services from your POS provider to speed up the process. <br> 4. Train: train staff on how to use the system efficiently to ensure accuracy in data entry and operations. Your POS provider may be able to assist. </p></div></details><details class=" gb-ui-dropdown-icon tw:border tw:border-solid tw:border-tertiary tw:rounded-md tw:mb-6 tw:relative tw:select-none " data-js="accordion"><summary class="tw:cursor-pointer tw:font-lsMedium tw:pt-4.5 tw:pr-18 tw:pb-4.5 tw:pl-6"><h3 class="gb-h4 gb-no-margin-bottom">Which is the best inventory management software for wholesale and retail businesses?</h3></summary><div class=" tw:mb-0 tw:mt-4.5 tw:text-primary tw:pt-4.5 tw:pr-18 tw:pb-4.5 tw:pl-6 tw:[&_li]:list-disc " data-accordion="content"><p>The best software for wholesale and retail is one that combines POS functionalities with inventory management in a single interface. Look for features like multi-store management, ecommerce integration and mobile accessibility, which allow retail managers to oversee their operations on the go. Effective software also provides detailed reports that aid in making informed purchasing decisions and optimizing product placement and promotions based on data-driven insights.<br><br> Selecting the best inventory management software for both wholesale and retail businesses is crucial for streamlining operations, reducing costs and enhancing customer satisfaction. Effective inventory management software should cater to the unique needs of both sectors, supporting extensive inventory volumes for wholesalers and diverse product assortments for retailers.<br><br> Retailers can manage their inventory efficiently by implementing software that offers real-time tracking, automated restocking alerts and detailed analytics on sales patterns and customer preferences. <br><br> Wholesalers typically manage large volumes of products and require robust software that can handle bulk processing and track inventory across multiple locations.
